Bilcare Limited.note: Bilcare Limited divested its global films business (Bilcare Research) to Lindsay Goldberg in 2019, but remains an independent public company itself.

Epaflex Polyurethanes S.r.l..note: Elachem S.p.A. acquired Epaflex Polyurethanes in 2008.

Hafliger Films S.p.A..note: Hafliger Films S.p.A. merged with and was acquired by UAB Lietpak in 2019.

RKW SE.note: RKW SE underwent an ownership reorganisation in 2019, becoming fully owned by the Müller and de Alvear families.

Shikoku Kakoh Co., Ltd..note: Shikoku Kakoh is an independent manufacturer operating under the Moriroku Group landscape.

Riken Technos Corporation.note: Riken Technos Corporation operates as an independent public company listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

AKRO-PLASTIC GmbH.note: AKRO-PLASTIC GmbH was acquired by K.D. Feddersen Group in 1992 and operates as a manufacturing subsidiary.

BEGO GmbH & Co. KG.note: The company remains an owner-managed, independent family business since its founding in 1890.

China Petroleum & Chemical Corporation.note: Sinopec was established in 2000 by the state-owned China Petrochemical Corporation and remains an independent listed enterprise.

Ekmen Plastik PVC Granül San. ve Tic. Lt.note: Originally founded in 1974 as Ekmen Kaucuk, the company transitioned to PVC granules in 1983 and remains independent.

Gema Polimer Plastik Ürünleri San. ve Ti.note: The company was established in 1996 following roots dating back to 1984 and remains an independent polymer specialist.

Indelpro, S.A. de C.V..note: Indelpro operates as a strategic joint venture between Alpek (part of Grupo Alfa) and LyondellBasell.

Karina Plásticos LTDA.note: Founded in 1979, the company remains an independent specialist in thermoplastic compounds.

Manak Polychem Enterprises.note: Established in 2006, the firm remains an independent manufacturer and distributor of PVC compounds and mineral powders.

Omega Polímeros.note: Omega Polímeros is an independent, privately owned plastic compounds manufacturer in Argentina with no verifiable record of past acquisition or corporate ownership changes.

Reliance Industries Limited.note: Reliance Industries Limited is the flagship entity of the conglomerate and acts as an ultimate buyer rather than an acquired party.

Shanghai New Shanghua Polymer Material C.note: The company remains an independent comprehensive plastics manufacturer formerly known as Shanghai Chemical Plant Co., Ltd.

Sunko Ink Co., Ltd..note: Sunko Ink Co., Ltd. remains an independent public company, though it changed its Chinese name to Kuo Ching Technology (Sunko Co., Ltd.) in 2026.

Toyobo MC Corporation.note: The company was established in 2023 as a joint venture between Toyobo Co., Ltd. (51%) and Mitsubishi Corporation (49%).

Zhejiang Huafon Thermoplastic Polyuretha.note: A 2026 revised acquisition proposal by its sister company Huafon Chemical to buy 100% equity from controlling shareholder Huafon Group is pending regulatory and final shareholder completion.

Kin Join Co., Ltd..note: Kin Join Co., Ltd. operates as an independent manufacturer of thermoplastic elastomers and polyurethanes.
